subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: Two-Factor Authentication
description: Learn Two-Factor Authentication in one minute.

hook.text: A password alone isn't enough anymore. Two-factor authentication adds a second lock on your account.

buildup.text: After entering your password, you provide a second factor: a code from your phone, a fingerprint, or a key.

discovery.text: Even if a hacker steals your password, they can't log in without the second factor in your possession.

twist.text: SMS-based two-factor is vulnerable to SIM-swapping attacks. App-based or hardware keys are much safer.

climax.text: Two-factor authentication isn't perfect, but it stops the vast majority of account takeover attacks.

punchline.text: Two locks. A stolen password isn't enough.

quiz.question: Why is SMS-based two-factor authentication less secure?
